input.quote: 5.2 The Company shall have exclusive artistic and editorial control over the Site, including, without limitation, the implementation of the Content on the Site and the design and look and feel of the Site.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no intellectual property ownership or assignment provision. HDI designs, develops and hosts the Site and receives all of the Company's Content, Marks and user information (Sections 1.1-1.4, 2.1, 8.1), and the Parties exchange customer e-mail lists (Section 7.1), yet nothing states who owns the Site deliverables, the Content or the customer and order data generated through the Site. The only related language is the negative covenant against co-ownership in Section 10.2, which addresses the corporate relationship rather than IP. Without an express clause we risk HDI asserting ownership of the Site deliverables it develops and of Site customer data. We therefore add a new Section 5.5 confirming Company ownership of Content, Deerskin Products materials and Site deliverables (with HDI assigning), HDI's retention of its pre-existing platform and tools subject to a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence back of any HDI IP embedded in the deliverables, exclusive Company ownership of Site customer/order data with a return obligation, and no joint ownership.

proposal.summary: Add ownership section: Company owns Content, Site deliverables and Site customer data; HDI keeps its platform but licenses embedded IP; no joint ownership.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on intellectual property, so we have added an ownership section confirming that we own our Content, the Site deliverables developed for us and all customer and order data collected through the Site, with HDI retaining its pre-existing platform and tools and granting us a perpetual, royalty-free licence to anything of its own embedded in the deliverables. We can accept a licence-back approach to the Site deliverables instead of assignment if HDI prefers, provided our ownership of Content and customer data is unqualified.

ops.text: 5.5 Ownership of Content, Deliverables and Data. (a) As between the Parties, the Company owns and shall retain all right, title and interest in and to the Content, the Marks, all materials relating to the Deerskin Products, and all designs, text, graphics, layout, look and feel and other deliverables and work product created or developed by or for HDI specifically for the Company or the Site under this Agreement (collectively, the "Company Materials"), and HDI hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest it may have in and to the Company Materials. (b) HDI retains all right, title and interest in and to its pre-existing computer systems, hosting platform, software, Content administration tools and general know-how, and hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, transferable license to use, reproduce, modify and sublicense any such HDI materials to the extent incorporated in, or reasonably necessary to use, the Company Materials or the Site. (c) All customer, user, order and transaction data, including customer e-mail lists, collected through the Site or otherwise in connection with Deerskin Products shall be the exclusive property of the Company; HDI may use such data solely as necessary to perform its obligations under this Agreement and shall, upon the Company's request and upon expiration or termination of this Agreement, deliver a copy of such data to the Company in a commercially reasonable format. (d) Nothing in this Agreement shall create any joint ownership of intellectual property, and neither Party acquires any right in the other Party's intellectual property except as expressly granted in this Agreement.
